title: Visual motion maps in explanations
changes: Each revealed Motion detective explanation now includes effort and load direction cards.
Directional arrows cover downward input, rising load, rotation, ramp travel, and splitting motion.
The ramp arrow follows the selected height/length ratio, including the vertical setting.
Cards stack on narrow phones and use system colors in forced-color mode.
Text distinguishes direction arrows from the distance scale on the front tracks.
publication: Local only; no commit, push, or deployment
